Class RmiServer

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
it.polimi.ingsw.net.rmi.server.RmiServer
All Implemented Interfaces:
RmiServerInterface, Serializable, Remote
public class RmiServer extends UnicastRemoteObject implements RmiServerInterface
RMI server implementation exposing remote methods for client connections and event handling. Binds itself to the RMI registry allowing clients to connect and send events. Retrieves the local IP address to properly configure the RMI hostname.

      public static RmiServer bind(ServerController serverController)
